description: A pre-failure narrow concrete cracks dataset for engineering structures damage classification and segmentation is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Karolina Tomaszkiewicz et al. Monitoring of structures’ condition plays a fundamental role in providing safety for users and extending the structures’ lifespan. The monitoring is conducted through on-site inspections by engineers thus this process is time-consuming, labor-intensive and prone to subjective engineering opinions. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
